agincourt-1415.short: English win; French vanguard cut down in the mud; rearguard never came on

albuera-1811.short: French columns take the heights' edge; Allies stand and Cole drives the French off

aljubarrota-1385.short: The French and Castilian attack breaks in the pits and the narrow front in under an hour; Juan I flees

babuna-1915.short: Serbs hold the crest all day against the Bulgarians, then retreat on orders at 22:00

badajoz-1812.losses: Allies far heavier (about 4,670 killed and wounded against 1,300-1,500 French)
badajoz-1812.short: Every attack on the breaches fails; the 3rd Division takes the castle by escalade, the 5th gets in at San Vicente (off the map), and the town falls

beaumont-hamel-1916.short: The 87th Brigade and then the Newfoundlanders are cut down in no man's land and at the wire; RIR 119 holds its line

bougainville-1944.short: Japanese seize pillboxes at the saddle; Americans restore the line over days

burgos-1812.losses: Allies heavier (421 killed and wounded against 198 French, 60 of them prisoners)
burgos-1812.short: The firing party and the Portuguese at the front, their ladders short, are thrown back; the light companies break in at the gorge and the garrison runs for the castle

bull-run-1861.short: Henry Hill changes hands; late Confederate brigades break the Union line

cassino-monastery-1944.short: Indian Division's night attack on Point 593 fails with heavy loss

cassino-poles-1944.short: Poles take 593 and are thrown off it the same day

cassino-town-1944.short: New Zealanders take Castle Hill; paratroops hold the south of the town (stalemate)

chipyong-1951.short: Chinese break into G Company's hill; the perimeter holds until the tanks come

cisterna-1944.short: Rangers pinned in the open short of the town; of 767, six got back

cowpens-1781.short: Morgan's double envelopment: the British line surrenders

crecy-1346.short: The Genoese are shot down and ridden over; charge after French charge breaks on the archers and the Prince's battle into the night

dakto-1967.short: First day: the paratroopers are stopped below the crest and cut off (crest taken four days later)

debecka-2003.losses: Iraqis heavier; the allies lost only to their own bomb
debecka-2003.short: Javelins from the Alamo stop the Iraqi counter-attack; a Navy bomb falls on the Kurds behind

dornach-1499.short: The Swiss fall on the camp and take the guns, hold through hours of counter-attacks, and break the imperial army when Lucerne and Zug come up

easting73-1991.short: Eagle Troop destroys the dug-in tank company in 23 minutes without loss

fallujah-2004.short: Marines and tanks clear the Jolan house by house; insurgents fall back south

fetterman-1866.short: Decoys draw the relief over the ridge; about a thousand warriors kill all 81

foxhill-1950.short: Chinese overrun forward squads; the Marines hold the crest (26 killed, 89 wounded of 240)

goosegreen-1982.short: 2 Para pinned for the morning, then breaks into the Darwin Hill line

grozny-1995.short: The brigade takes the station, is cut off overnight and destroyed breaking out

hamburger-1969.short: After ten days the summit is taken about noon

heartbreak-1951.short: Night attack along the crest; Hill 931 taken before noon

hue-1968.short: Marines take the provincial headquarters building by building after two days

jacobsford-1179.losses: Templars near all killed or taken
jacobsford-1179.short: The mined corner falls at dawn and the castle is stormed; the garrison is killed or taken

kapyong-1951.short: Australians hold the hill all night (32 killed, 59 wounded), then fall back in order

keating-2009.short: Insurgents break in from the east; the Americans retake the outpost by the afternoon

khesanh-1968.short: NVA break into E Company's trenches; Shanley's counter-attack throws them out (7 Marines killed, 100+ NVA dead)

lundys-lane-1814.short: Americans take the guns in the dark and hold the crest against three counter-attacks; both exhausted

lutzen-1632.short: Swedes storm the windmill battery late; the Imperialists withdraw in the night

mogadishu-1993.short: The force holds round the crash site through the night until relieved

mojkovac-1916.short: Montenegrins beat off the attack by noon and hold the Bojna njiva; Reinöhl killed leading his last reserves

mons-1914.short: Rifle and machine-gun fire cut down the Germans; the British fall back by afternoon

osan-1950.short: Tanks drive through; infantry work round both flanks; Task Force Smith withdraws

porkchop-1953.short: Chinese overrun the trenches; K and L Companies take the hill back

redan-1855.short: British reach the salient, stall on the parapet, and are thrown back

redan-1855-june.short: The columns are swept by grape in the open; the attack is called off

sidon-1253.short: The Damascenes break into the unfinished walls and cut the garrison down

snipe-1942.short: The six-pounders hold the hollow from dawn to dark; some 32 tanks and 5 SP guns burnt out round it for 72 British killed and wounded

topolcani-1915.losses: not known; a few Serbian wounded seen
topolcani-1915.short: Bulgarians take the trenches about midday in a blizzard; the Serbs go at twilight over the bridge

towton-1461.short: Hours of fighting; Norfolk arrives; the Lancastrian line breaks and is slaughtered in the rout

tumbledown-1982.short: Left Flank held in the crags for four hours, then the bayonets; the summit taken at dawn

visby-1361.short: The Danish professionals crush the Gotland levies

wagon-box-1867.short: Breech-loaders hold the corral against mounted and foot attacks

wanat-2008.short: The post is nearly overrun; reinforcements hold it until the fighters are driven off

xray-1965.losses: NVA far heavier (79 US killed over three days)
xray-1965.short: The landing zone holds under assault from three sides
